events.title: The Art of Touch
events.description:
## The Art Of Touch

A Foundational Massage Practitioner Course\
27.10 – 30.10 2025

Would you like to learn how to give (and receive) a heart-centred, deeply relaxing massage\
Maybe you’ve been feeling a certain energy in your hands and a wish to explore the field of massage and bodywork

In this 4-day training course you will learn principles and techniques that will give you the skills and confidence to give a full body relaxation massage with oil

Throughout the course you'll explore both the physical as well as energetic aspects of massage therapy\
The main focus is the quality of touch and the connection between giver and receiver rather than anatomy knowledge

### Who is this for

For anyone who would like to explore the gifts we can bring through touch\
For beginners as well as those already practicing healing arts who want to deepen understanding

### Learning outcomes

* Foundations to give a deeply relaxing nurturing massage with confidence
* Techniques for a complete full body massage
* Effects of massage therapy on body-mind and nervous system
* Deeper connection with yourself and your body
* Keep energy flowing without getting exhausted as a giver
* Attunement and intuitive sensitivity
* Attitude of loving presence
* Connect with a small international group to continue practicing
* Receive a video of the sequence you learn

### Workshop hours

* Saturday 11:00–17:30
* Sunday 11:00–18:30
* Monday 10:00–16:30
* Tuesday 11:00–18:30

Shared vegetarian lunch each day

### 3-tier pricing

* 370€ low income
* 410€ fair
* 450€ supportive

Small group (max. 8 participants)\
Workshop held in English, translations into German and Spanish possible\
60€ referral discount, bring a friend\
One helper spot available for 275€

Registration contact as listed on the page via Telegram/WhatsApp: +351927576899

### Meet the Facilitator

Julia Ocean\
Therapeutic massage practitioner, yoga teacher and multifaceted artist\
Passionate about facilitating deep relaxation and nurturing and creating transformative healing experiences through loving presence and mindful touch

#### Here is one of my latest reviews:

> I had the wonderful opportunity to participate in Julia’s massage course, which gave me a deep and well-rounded insight into her work and teaching style. From the very beginning, the atmosphere felt incredibly warm, familiar, and truly on eye-level — something I deeply value, especially as a learner.
>
> The course offered a beautiful balance between theory and practice. Julia was always open to questions and made sure everyone felt seen and supported. I learned so much — especially the massage basics, the do’s and don’ts — making this course perfect for anyone starting out.
>
> The setting was absolutely stunning, and sharing our lunch breaks with potluck meals brought the group even closer together. It felt more like a shared journey than just a course. Julia is not only an amazing teacher, but also a beautiful soul. Truly a special experience that I can wholeheartedly recommend.
>
> Miriam

## Autumn Yoga Retreat with Ehud Neuhaus
ALGARVE, PORTUGAL  
OCTOBER 31th – NOVEMBER 5th 2025

A few immersive days of yoga, stillness and connection  
Explore a functional approach to yoga, daily Yang & Yin practices, meditation and philosophy workshops

### What to expect
- Functional approach to yoga: honor uniqueness in all aspects of practice, daily vigorous Yang movement, quiet Yin time and meditation
- Daily practice & meditation: 2 daily classes (Yang and Yin), morning meditation, workshops on philosophy
- Nourishment & relaxation: 3 daily plant-based meals, sauna and hot tub under the open sky
- Workshops: two afternoons diving into yoga philosophy

### The Facilitator
Ehud Neuhaus  
Practising yoga 20+ years, teaching since 2014  
Assisted Anat Geiger and Marcel van de Vis Heil in Functional Yoga Teacher Training since 2013  
Studied with Paul and Suzee Grilley (Yin Yoga)  
Founded the online platform The Fat Yogis with Anat and Marcel

events.title: The Embodied Woman
events.description:
## The Embodied Woman
An AUTHENTIC SHAPES RETREAT  
ALGARVE, PORTUGAL  
OCTOBER 7th – 11th 2025

Embodied wisdom begins when a woman listens to her body

Five days to reconnect with your body, return to your inner truth and embody your natural feminine strength

You crave deeper intimacy and a more embodied connection with yourself and with others  
But the daily hustle pulls you out of your flow  
When we give ourselves space to feel, we notice what’s truly going on inside  
Emotions may surface  
Forgotten parts of ourselves may begin to speak  
And in that quiet awareness, something powerful is revealed

Your body holds wisdom  
When we learn to truly listen, our body guides us  
It tells us when to rest, when to move, when to say yes and when to say no  
This is what it means to live in alignment — to trust the voice within instead of seeking validation from the outside  
You don’t need to become more or do more  
Your strength is already within you — ready to be felt, expressed and shared

### The Facilitator
Cindy de Vogel  
Mentor, trauma-informed breathwork facilitator, 1:1 coach, sacred space holder, somatic yoga teacher

## Harvest of the Heart
A 5RHYTHMS HEARTBEAT RETREAT  
ALGARVE, PORTUGAL  
SEPTEMBER 6–11, 2025

Step away from the noise and into the rhythm of integration

A 6-day, 5-night 5Rhythms retreat in the raw beauty of nature — where land, sea and sky invite you to dance through the change of the season, release what’s ready to go and harvest what’s truly yours

This retreat offers a chance to step away from daily routines and into a rhythm that reflects the shifting season  
Through 5Rhythms Waves & Heartbeat, move with cycles of fullness, release and deep integration — allowing the body to unwind, the heart to open and the mind to soften  
Movement as a way to reclaim presence, emotional clarity and embodied freedom

Set in Essência’s secluded retreat center between rolling hills and the vast ocean  
Enjoy sauna session, refreshing dips in the wild lake, nourishing vegan meals and time to breathe in the raw beauty of the land  
Between sessions: walk the coastline, rest under the open sky and let nature guide you back to center

### The Facilitators
Vehllia Tranne & Alessandro Moruzzi  
Certified 5Rhythms® Teachers and founders of The City Waves 5Rhythms® (San Francisco)
